pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Cursed Pyramid.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: Brush suspicious sand in the Cursed Pyramid for the Necklace of the Desert. In singleplayer use it on a Remnant without a necklace: it is consumed and awakening begins. Sidestep a charge and leave the rear sector during a tail swing.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat. Arrows are rejected in most states except a particular vulnerable action. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Sandstorm in a Bottle, Remnant's Skull, Block of Ancient Metal. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. In an active campaign this main-boss victory is linked to the Old Eye. First record the branch victories: Dune Sentinel, Mummy, Golden Hermit King. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.
